# Matt Rae

> Matt Rae is a senior product manager at Adobe working on AI in Photoshop and
> Lightroom. He is a conference speaker on creative workflows, AI agents and
> assistants, design, and product management; a landscape and travel
> photographer; and is available for hire for web design and build,
> photography, and team workshops. Based in Canada.

## Key facts
- Role: Senior Product Manager, Adobe (Photoshop & Lightroom)
- Available for hire: web design & build, photography, workshops — see /work-with-me
- Location: Canada
- Contact: matt@mattrae.ca
